tools.name: flu_region_snapshot
tools.description: What is the latest weekly flu count per sentinel for Japan, a prefecture or a covered health-center area? ISO week, value, recent weeks, official warning/advisory where announced (status_basis official), separate from a comparison with reference values (status_basis computed), school-closure counts

tools.name: flu_region_history
tools.description: What changed in the recorded influenza figures for a Japanese region since a date? Versions this service recorded: new weeks (first_recorded) and revised values (revised, with the old value) of weekly per-sentinel figures, official statuses and school-closure counts, with observed_at, source URL and

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
